question.en: Discuss the evolution of money and its significance in the modern Indian economy.

introduction.en: Money is any item or verifiable record that is generally accepted as payment for goods and services and repayment of debts. It has evolved from commodity-based systems to digital fiat systems.
introduction.hi: Money is any item or verifiable record that is generally accepted as payment for goods and services and repayment of debts. It has evolved from commodity-based systems to digital fiat systems.

body.en: The evolution of money has moved from barter to metallic coins, paper currency, and now digital forms. In India, money facilitates trade, acts as a store of value, and is a unit of account. The RBI's push for digital payments and the introduction of the e-Rupee (CBDC) represent the next phase of this evolution, enhancing transparency and reducing transaction costs.

conclusion.en: Money remains the backbone of the modern economy. As India moves toward a less-cash society, the focus must remain on financial literacy and digital security.
